[LLSU.8.1] Upward fact flow to a higher tier (integrator-defined).
Distinct from intra-tier `emit` (in `core`) because it
crosses a tier boundary with TTL and overflow semantics.

| Name | Explanation | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|
| `publish` | `publish <Schema>` — cross-tier upward assertion | reach the other tier through a `call` |
| `publish_overflow_policy` | `overflow <policy>` per-schema on cross-tier wire (drop-oldest / persist-through-storage / drop-newest) | accept the runtime's default policy |
